title: You’re not failing — you’re being fortified.
paragraphs:
You’re not failing — you’re being fortified.
When your strength runs out, God’s strength steps in.
Your weakness is not the end of your story… it’s the doorway where His power begins.
Let Him turn what you fear into what fuels you. 💛✨
“My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.” — 2 Corinthians 12:9 (NIV)
